title: AeroSync
description: An ultra-lightweight client build that squeezes the maximum FPS and smoothness out of your hardware without sacrificing the game's original atmosphere
body:
AeroSync — Minecraft Performance
AeroSync is a lightweight modpack for Minecraft designed strictly to boost performance, increase FPS, and ensure game smoothness. It works entirely under the hood and does not alter vanilla gameplay mechanics.

What exactly does this project do
⚡ Boosts Framerate (FPS): Core optimization mods (Sodium and Lithium) completely overhaul the rendering engine and game logic for maximum performance and high FPS.

🚀 Reduces RAM Usage: Mods like FerriteCore and ModernFix optimize memory management, leading to faster startup times and lower RAM consumption.

👁️ Optimizes Rendering: The EntityCulling mod prevents the game from rendering hidden objects (mobs, chests) outside your field of view, drastically improving performance.

🌐 Improves Network Code: Network optimizations lower latency and minimize packet loss on servers.

Why should you download AeroSync
📈 Maximum FPS: The pack squeezes every bit of frames out of your hardware, eliminating lags, FPS drops, and micro-stutters.

💻 Great for Everyone: It runs perfectly on both low-end laptops and high-end computers, ensuring a perfectly smooth gaming experience.

🎮 Pure Vanilla Feel: The game looks exactly like the standard version, but runs much faster. A handy mod settings button is already included in the main menu.

Important Information & Installation
⚙️ Technical Info: The modpack runs on the Fabric loader. All required libraries are already included in the package — no extra downloads needed.

📥 How to install:
Download the .mrpack file
Import it into any launcher that supports Modrinth format (like Modrinth App or Prism Launcher)
